name: Twisted Tetra
tooltip:
Twisted Tetra
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
An eel whose body camouflages within the roots that make up the riverbeds of the Harandar. The Twisted Tetra lies in wait for Bloomtail Minnows who become too comfortable with their surroundings.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill will produce Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Harandar
- Zul'Aman

Fishing Pools:
- Obscured School
- Lashing Waves

Rates:
- This fish is mostly found in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
